runs.scope: Local native echo through plaintext SOCKS; TCP sizes are application messages, not IP packets. Four persistent connections, one outstanding request each. Native upstream and generator CPU recorded separately. WinINet HTTP creates new requests and includes Python origin/driver overhead; not directly comparable to persistent TCP. No allocation stack sampling.
